title: E0007: Method parameters count
plain_english: Methods with many parameters can be hard to read, call, and change.
why_matters: A long parameter list often means a method is handling too many responsibilities or missing an abstraction. Reducing parameter count can make the method's purpose clearer and reduce the chance of passing arguments in the wrong order.
bad_example:
<?php

class Maintenance
{
    public function execute(
        Hammer $hammer,
        Screw $screw,
        Screwdriver $screwDriver,
        Nails $nails,
        Paint $paint,
        SandingPaper $sandingPaper,
        Painting $painting,
        Brush $brush,
        Ladder $ladder
    ) {
    }
}
good_example:
<?php

interface Activity
{
    /** @return array<int, object> */
    public function getTools(): array;
}

class Maintenance
{
    public function execute(Activity ...$activities): void
    {
        foreach ($activities as $activity) {
            $tools = $activity->getTools();
            // Use tools.
        }
    }
}

class Paint implements Activity
{
    public function getTools(): array
    {
        return [];
    }
}
what_it_checks: The number of parameters declared by a method.
